core.title: Reference every WMBT from at least one feature
core.given: The plan contains one or more WMBTs.
core.when: You author, change or validate the plan.
core.then: Every WMBT must appear in the declared WMBT list of at least one feature (WMBT -> feature coverage).
prefer: When authoring a WMBT, add it in the same change to the declared WMBT list of the feature it serves.
When splitting, renaming or removing a feature, re-home each of its WMBTs into another feature's declared WMBT list.
avoid: Orphan WMBTs that no feature references, whether new or pre-existing.
Gaming coverage by dumping unrelated WMBTs into an arbitrary or catch-all feature just to satisfy the check.
core.why: A WMBT that no feature references is untraceable to user-facing value and falls outside wagon/feature coverage; WMBT -> feature coverage is the link that lets lower-level coverage (WMBT -> acceptance) roll up to features and wagons.
evidence: The WMBT -> feature coverage check passes: every WMBT appears in at least one feature's declared WMBT list.
A reviewer can map each WMBT in the plan to a feature whose list names it.
verification: The check covers the WMBT -> feature direction only: it requires every WMBT to be named by at least one feature and does not check the feature -> WMBT direction (a feature listing WMBTs beyond the minimum is not a violation).
The check is whole-plan: it applies to every WMBT in the plan, including orphans that pre-exist the current change, not only to newly changed files.

The check enumerates both sides of coverage by plan-artifact kind from the profile: the covered artifacts (WMBTs) and the covering artifacts (features), the latter each carrying a coverage list read through the profile's coverage-list construct, and requires every covered WMBT to be named by at least one covering feature; the concrete validator and finding identifiers of this rule are realization details named by each stack.
Disposition: documentation-only (per-rule severity and disposition are properties of the rule, not profile data).

fires: The plan contains a WMBT that no feature's declared WMBT list names, including orphans that pre-exist the current change.
The plan contains WMBTs but no features at all.
A feature exists but declares no WMBT list, leaving WMBTs unreferenced.
Example changes that commonly create orphans: adding a WMBT without listing it, renaming a WMBT while features keep the old name, editing or removing a feature's WMBT list, or removing a feature.
doesNotFire: Every WMBT in the plan is named in at least one feature's declared WMBT list.
A feature lists WMBTs beyond the minimum (only the WMBT -> feature direction is checked).

profileRequirements.meaning: The concrete artifact kinds that play the plan-artifact role, covering both sides of the coverage enumeration: the covered kind (a WMBT, which must be listed) and the covering kind (a feature, which carries the coverage list that names it). The check enumerates covered WMBT artifacts and covering feature artifacts in the plan tree by these kinds.
The construct by which a covering feature artifact declares the plan artifacts it covers - the list in which every WMBT must be named for the WMBT -> feature coverage check.

proposedKeys.meaning: The construct by which a covering plan artifact (a feature) lists the plan artifacts it covers (its WMBTs); a coverage check matches each covered artifact against these lists.
proposedKeys.whyNoExistingKey: urn.binding.<artifact> covers a source or test file binding itself to one artifact, and urn.declaration covers an artifact declaring its own URN; no existing key describes one plan artifact listing the other plan artifacts it covers.

neutralityNotes: The plan-graph terms WMBT, feature, wagon and acceptance are ATDD methodology concepts (they appear as parametric values in the closed vocabulary, e.g. urn.wmbt) and are kept in the core; they name no stack, runtime, framework, language, package manager, suffix or path. The concrete identification of both sides of the coverage enumeration in the plan - the covered WMBT kind and the covering feature kind - comes from roles.plan_artifact.kinds (Bun: wmbt, feature, identifiable by file kind in the plan tree), and the feature's listing construct (Bun: the wmbts list) is carried by the proposed key urn.coverage_list, since no existing vocabulary key fits that direction. Validator, term and finding identifiers (test_all_wmbts_in_at_least_one_feature, wmbt_feature_coverage) and the sidecar metadata.disposition pointer are Bun-only realization details; the per-rule disposition (documentation-only) is kept in core.verification per the notProfileKeys rule.
